about: Known parity items that parity_compare.py would fail as NEW or CRASH (a tsc-rs crash or timeout, whatever the base says). An entry excuses its item only while the item has exactly this status and rsFailure and its detail contains detailContains; compare prints each excused item with its reason, and every entry that no longer applies as STALE GRANDFATHER. Add an item only with a reason a reviewer can check; remove it when it changes. Lane H3, 2026-11-05: the 35 fuzz cases of the full batch where Go itself crashes or times out and tsc-rs does too (from runs/h2-head-efef52257-full-2, the H2 gate on tsgo-head-efef52257-rel).
